tools.name: change_sintia_language
tools.description: Change the Sintia website language preference and persist it in the user cookie.

locale.description: Target language: es for Spanish, en for English.

tools.name: contact_sintia_sales
tools.description: Open the official Sintia WhatsApp sales channel so the human can request a demo or proposal.

reason.description: Optional short reason for contacting sales.

tools.name: estimate_sintia_plan
tools.description: Estimate Sintia pricing for a given number of users, plan, billing cycle, and currency.

seats.description: Number of active users or students to estimate.

plan.description: Plan to estimate. Defaults to standard.

billing.description: Billing cycle. Annual applies the published annual discount.

currency.description: Currency for the estimate. Defaults to COP.

tools.name: get_sintia_pricing_summary
tools.description: Return public Sintia plan anchors and recommended use cases in COP, USD, or EUR.

currency.description: Currency for the pricing snapshot. Defaults to COP.

tools.name: get_sintia_summary
tools.description: Return the official concise summary of Sintia, its audience, differentiators, and recommended next actions.

tools.name: list_sintia_products
tools.description: List Sintia product modules with summaries, audiences, top features, and canonical URLs.
